about: How vts asks Twitch for channels and their live streams (Twitch's public GraphQL interface, as its website does). Updated with youtube.json: bump revision (YYYYMMDDNN) when changing it.

queries.users: query($logins:[String!]){users(logins:$logins){login displayName description profileImageURL(width:150) followers{totalCount} stream{title viewersCount createdAt type game{displayName} previewImageURL(width:440,height:248)}}}
queries.search: query($query:String!){searchUsers(userQuery:$query,first:20){edges{node{login displayName description profileImageURL(width:150) followers{totalCount} stream{title viewersCount createdAt type game{displayName} previewImageURL(width:440,height:248)}}}}}
